newsitem.title: USA: Medialink acquires On Line Broadcasting.
newsitem.headline: Medialink acquires On Line Broadcasting.

text.p: Medialink Worldwide Inc said Monday it has acquired London-based, privately-held, On Line Broadcasting Ltd, for an initial purchase price of about $82,000 (50,000 pound sterling) and 21,995 shares of Medialink common stock based upon a valuation of $10 per share.
The company said more shares will be issued to On Line's shareholders based on annualized revenues and profits between March 1 through December 31.
On Line Broadcasting, a provider of audio and video communications services, reported revenues of about $310,000 (190,000 pounds) in 1996.
Medialink provides broadcast media and consultation services, and satellite distribution of television and radio broadcasts to corporations and other organizations.
